Domain_Knowledge_Database_Schema.Domain_Knowledge_Overview: Domain Knowledge provides comprehensive knowledge about the semiconductor FAB digital twin. Domain Knowledge consists of three areas: Digital Twin Database Schema, Manufacturing System Knowledge, and Simulation Knowledge. When an analysis request is received, refer to Domain Knowledge when generating the response.
Domain_Knowledge_Database_Schema.Digital_Twin_Database_Schema:
The Digital Twin Database Schema is the database structure used to store semiconductor FAB digital-twin data. The DBMS of the semiconductor FAB digital-twin database is MariaDB. The name of the semiconductor FAB digital-twin database is 'smt_2020_llm'. Tables in the digital-twin database are divided into master data and result data according to their purpose. Master data is the input information required to design the semiconductor FAB digital twin. Result data is historical information generated while the semiconductor FAB digital twin is running. When generating a response to an analysis request, create a DQL query (SELECT) to obtain the required data. (MariaDB) When creating a DQL query, refer to the table structures in the digital-twin database.

The queuetimelog table contains the history of lots passing through constrained intervals between processes in the semiconductor FAB.
